condition: Under NEP 50, an IntEnum or IntFlag member is treated as a strongly typed int64 rather than a weak Python int, so bitwise ops (including in-place |=) with smaller or unsigned integer arrays raise a UFuncTypeError casting error.
workaround: Convert the enum member to a plain int before the operation, e.g. arr |= int(MyEnum.X) or arr |= MyEnum.X.value.
